note: Shoshone NF (Washakie Ranger District) campground on the west shore of Worthen Meadow Reservoir, southwest of Lander: 10 miles up WY 131, then 8.5 miles on FR 300. Wooded sites; boat ramp on the peninsula, and the reservoir is for non-motorized boats. Trailheads into the Popo Agie Wilderness at the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov info listing read: 28 FCFS sites, 24-ft spurs (no trailers over 24 ft; a 23-ft rig fits), $20 cash/check, 16-day limit, potable water + vault toilets (all manual; max_stay 16 added). Lakeview holds (spurs under canopy; one possible open spur end by the shore logged as a lead). Phone empty -> 307-332-5460. Pin ~175 m from the spur network - fine. Note trimmed of field repeats.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview (not --AWH) holds. The campground's spurs run under continuous conifer canopy between the access road and the west shore; the reservoir shows through the trees from the spurs nearest the shore. The old evidence's 'NW loop/vehicles on open ground overlook water ~40-60m' is the Sheeps Bridge/Upper Brewers trailhead lot (OSM 42.70012,-108.93172), not campsites. LEAD (not an upgrade): one short spur at the north end of the spur network ends on an open sandy patch ~15 m from the shoreline at about 42.6993,-108.9296 - it may be a lakefront site, but there is no FS site map or site list to number it or confirm it is a campsite, so lakeview stays.

PENINSULA: the boat ramp (OSM slipway 42.6996,-108.9261), a large open turnaround and a small treed loop (OSM camp_site node 42.69869,-108.92536) sit on the peninsula ~400 m east of the spur network; recreation.gov names a 'Worthen Meadow Picnic Area' nearby. Whether that small loop holds any of the 28 campsites is not stated anywhere I read; its east side is ~40 m from the water through a tree band. Not a split candidate (shared entrance road, ~400 m).
FIT: 'Maximum spur length is 24 feet' (FS) / 'No trailers over 24 feet' (rec.gov) - a 23-ft rig fits with about a foot to spare; no flag beyond that.
SEASON: no season stated (FS 'Operational Hours Open 24 hours/day'); left unset. 'Site Closed - Closed for the season' is the ordinary end-of-season banner.

PHONE: empty -> 307-332-5460 (Washakie Ranger District, FS page contact). Website https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/shoshone/recreation/worthen-meadow-campground confirmed current. recreation.gov 240434 is information-only (not a booking channel); its official_site_url is the old recid=36391 link.

PIN: stored 42.69769,-108.92915 is at the entrance junction on the access road, ~175 m from the spur network's centre (FS point 42.69902,-108.92999; OSM 42.69915,-108.93017) - under 250 m; optional move to 42.69905,-108.93005.
Neighbours Fiddlers Lake (6464), Louis Lake (6398) and Sinks Canyon SP (6359) are already in the database; no leads.
